items.t: Said poverty, lack of education and lack of opportunity are drivers of crime that Arkansas needs to fix in order to reduce violent crime.
items.q: There are drivers of crime like poverty, lack of education, and lack of opportunity, that Arkansas needs to fix in order to reduce violent crime. They’re generational.

record.t: Presented the three bills in the ATRS Legislative Package at a Joint Retirement Committee meeting, along with Senator Kim Hammer and another presenter.
record.q: Senator Kim Hammer , Representative Andrew Collins , and I presented the three bills in the ATRS Legislative Package.

record.t: Presented HB1186 and HB1187 on the House floor, and both passed out of the House.
record.q: HB1186 and HB1187 were passed out of the House this week. They are on the Senate calendar for next week. Thank you to Representative Andrew Collins for presenting these bills on the House floor this week.

record.t: Sponsored HB1188, which was signed by Governor Sanders and became Act 104.
record.q: HB1188 has been signed by Governor Sanders and is now Act 104 . Act 104 clarifies some of the language related to the use of partial years in the final average salary and better defines anti-spiking. I want to express my appreciation to Representative Andrew Collins for sponsoring this bill.

record.t: Introduced a bill with state Sen. Greg Leding in March that passed the state Senate in April.
record.q: State Rep. Andrew Collins, D-Little Rock, and state Sen. Greg Leding, a Democrat who represents the 4th District, introduced the bill in March, and it passed the state Senate in April.
